verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a local model runtime that runs GGUF quantized models, so whether runtime upgrades break previously downloaded model files is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains nothing on this: no compatibility policy, no release or migration notes, no format-versioning guarantees, and no breakage warnings. Mentions of GGUF loading and automatic backend downloads do not address upgrade compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
